summary.text: Anthony Phillips is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 56 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Grace Abitz in a race with no incumbent.
He ran for Wisconsin State Senate District 18 in 2024, losing to Democrat Kristin Alfheim.

paragraphs.text: Phillips's campaign website says he lives in Appleton, where he and his wife, Heidi, raised five children.
It describes Fox Valley Hematology and Oncology as an independent business with eventually 130 employees, and says he was part owner of nine Sola Salon franchises from 2013 to 2022.
It says he led efforts in 2007, in coordination with the American Cancer Society, that resulted in Appleton becoming the second Wisconsin municipality to ban smoking in restaurants.
The website says Phillips was the lone conservative on Governor Evers's People's Maps Commission in 2020–2021 and is a board member of Fox Valley Conservatives.
